description: On the tabletop there’s a small green-lidded plastic container, a purple block, a white earbud case, a tiny plush charm, and a small ring-shaped fidget piece near the middle. The left hand stays resting near the earbud case while the right hand moves in from the right, pinches the ring-shaped piece between the fingers, lifts it up, carries it forward and slightly left, and drops it into the open green container before withdrawing.
